exposure: Previous cesarean delivery due to failed vacuum delivery
outcome: Factors associated with vaginal delivery following failed vacuum delivery
cohort: 115 secundiparas who underwent a planned cesarean delivery or trial of labor after cesarean (TOLAC) at a single medical center between 2006 and 2019
finding: Among secundiparas with a previous cesarean delivery due to failed vacuum delivery, a lower neonatal birth weight was significantly associated with achieving vaginal birth after cesarean (VBAC).
mod_finding: A higher neonatal birth weight was associated with a failed trial of labor after cesarean (TOLAC).
birth_weight: Neonatal birth weight was measured and compared between groups.
